reasoning: Base ratings: the Grizzlies are -1.2 and the Nuggets +3.4 points per game against an average team; with home court that makes the Nuggets 10.1 better here, total 234.
Rest, travel and availability move it 0.7 towards the Grizzlies.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: Nuggets by 9.4, 75% to win; total 235 (80% range 211-259).
